'''Arlene''' is [[Arymilla Marne]]'s maid. She is slim, pretty, and seems to be young 
==History==

Arymilla thinks of her as knowing what she likes, and Arlene always makes her choices for which bed Arymilla will sleep in.

To distract Lord [[Nasin Caeren]] from [[Elenia Sarand]], Arymilla sends Arlene away with him to his tent, supposedly to fix him a spiced wine. Arlene is not at all happy to be chosen out to serve Nasin's lusts and Elenia finds it disgusting to offer one's own maid for this.
